collection.description: A diver finds a mollusk that may hold a pearl, but its kind is scarce.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A diver finds a large mollusk that might contain a pearl, but it is also part of a sparse breeding population.

choices.label: Ask the village to debate harvesting

b.name: Answer B
b.text: No pearl appears, but the shell becomes a prized carving.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A tense meeting reveals how much the pearl would mean to a family; the outcome depends on consent and scarcity.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: The diver records the location and later sees young mollusks nearby.
